chains.title: GATA3 alt-A activator chain
chains.element: The rs2168101 alt A allele strengthens or creates a GATA3-binding site in an LMO1 enhancer element.
chains.cell_type: Neuroblastoma cells, represented by SK-N-SH, which are compatible with neural-crest-derived sympathetic lineage expression of GATA3.

links.claim: GATA3 binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref C at rs2168101.
rs2168101 lies in an LMO1 enhancer whose activity is increased by the alt A allele.
Increased enhancer activity raises LMO1 expression.
This occurs in neuroblastoma cells such as SK-N-SH.
Higher LMO1 promotes neuroblastoma risk or malignant phenotype.

predictions: GATA3 binds A probe more than C probe
GATA3 occupies the LMO1 enhancer in SK-N-SH
A allele associates with higher LMO1 expression
falsified_if: Allele-specific EMSA shows no differential GATA3 binding between C and A.
GATA3 ChIP-seq/ChIP-qPCR at the LMO1 locus does not show GATA3 occupancy or allele preference.
GATA3 knockdown does not reduce LMO1 expression in SK-N-SH.

chains.title: Null: linked causal variant, passenger, or no allelic effect
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at rs2168101
No allele-specific effect on LMO1 expression attributable to this variant
Association is explained by linkage disequilibrium with another causal variant or by no causal effect
falsified_if: A robust allele-specific TF binding difference and TF-dependent LMO1 expression change are demonstrated.

chains.title: GATA2 ref-C repressor-loss chain
chains.element: The ref C allele preserves a stronger GATA2-binding site in an LMO1 enhancer; the alt A allele weakens it.

links.claim: GATA2 binds the ref C allele more strongly than alt A at rs2168101.
The ref C allele maintains a GATA2-responsive repressive or modulatory LMO1 enhancer element.
Loss of GATA2 binding from the alt A allele derepresses LMO1.
This occurs in neuroblastoma cells such as SK-N-SH.
Derepressed LMO1 increases neuroblastoma risk or malignant phenotype.

predictions: C probe binds GATA2 more than A probe
GATA2 occupancy is stronger on the C allele
GATA2 knockdown increases LMO1 if GATA2 is repressive
A allele associates with higher LMO1 expression
falsified_if: EMSA supershift shows GATA3 rather than GATA2 binding at the variant.
GATA2 knockdown has no effect on LMO1 expression.
There is no allele-specific GATA2 binding.

chains.title: SOX10 alt-A enhancer chain
chains.element: The alt A allele alters an LMO1 enhancer element recognized by SOX10 rather than by GATA factors.
chains.cell_type: Neuroblastoma cells, represented by SK-N-SH, with neural-crest transcription factor activity.

links.claim: SOX10 binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref C at rs2168101.
The alt A allele increases activity of a SOX10-responsive LMO1 enhancer element.
Increased enhancer activity raises LMO1 expression.
This occurs in neural-crest-derived neuroblastoma cells such as SK-N-SH.
Higher LMO1 promotes neuroblastoma risk or malignant phenotype.

predictions: SOX10 binds A probe more than C probe
GATA3/GATA2 antibodies do not supershift the allele-specific complex
falsified_if: SOX10 does not bind either allele at rs2168101.
SOX10 knockdown does not change LMO1 expression.
GATA3/GATA2 supershift explains the allele-specific binding.

matrix.test: Allele-specific EMSA with SK-N-SH nuclear extract plus GATA3 and GATA2 antibody supershifts

outcomes.outcome: A probe shifted more; GATA3 antibody supershifts the allele-specific complex
C probe shifted more; GATA2 antibody supershifts the allele-specific complex
A probe shifted more; SOX10 antibody supershifts, GATA antibodies do not

next_experiment: Cheapest single experiment separating H1 from H2: allele-specific EMSA using C and A rs2168101 probes with SK-N-SH nuclear extract, followed by anti-GATA3 and anti-GATA2 supershifts to determine both the preferred allele and the responsible TF.
